title: lint-loc aggregate gate FAILS: manifest cites ISS-001/ISS-002 bare (tracker G4)
detail: node scripts/lint-loc.mjs --all => stage=tracker exit=1, "lint:structure: FAIL (10 stages, 1 failed)": qa/manifests/visionfix.md cites ISS-001, ISS-002 bare while lane shard qa/issues.ollamafirst.jsonl numbers them ISS-OLLAMAFIRST-001/002. The manifest claims lint OK (10 stages, 0 failed); that is false at ef55b13e.
fix_direction: Qualify the ids in the manifest as ISS-OLLAMAFIRST-001/002 and re-run lint-loc --all.

title: extractJsonObject scans quadratically: unclosed-brace input blocks the event loop
detail: For each "{" the inner loop scans to end of text. Measured: "{" x32000 = 4683 ms, x8000 = 269 ms, x2000 = 22 ms (about n^2); "{\"" x16000 = 2416 ms; an unbalanced 200 KB reply would block for minutes and the abort timer cannot fire during it. Reply size is not capped before extraction.
fix_direction: Cap reply length before extracting (e.g. 256 KB) and/or stop scanning once a start has run to EOF without closing (an unterminated start means no later start closes either at the same depth); single-pass candidate scan.

title: Mutation survivors: apps/api httpTransport signal, 45s backend default, string-aware brace scanning, outer-signal path untested
detail: Survived: removing signal from apps/api/src/ai-transport.ts httpTransport (ai-transport.test.ts 17/17 pass); DEFAULT_VISION_BACKEND_TIMEOUT_MS 45000->120000 (21/21); disabling inStr string tracking in extractJsonObject (21/21); disabling the outer-signal abort in withAbortTimeout (21/21, no caller passes ctx.signal, dead path). Real httpTransport abort was proven manually by the checker (abort after 1030 ms, server saw close) but no repo test covers it.
fix_direction: Add a localhost never-responding-server test of realTransport with an AbortSignal; assert default 45000; add a reply with braces inside a JSON string that only parses with string tracking.
